Calculate the number of rays per patch: $N_{patch} = H_p \times W_p$.
where $W_{img}$ and $H_{img}$ are image width and height.
Generate all ray indices $(u, v)$ for $u \in [u_0, u_0 + W_p - 1]$ and $v \in [v_0, v_0 + H_p - 1]$.
Convert indices to ray origins and directions using the camera projection matrix.
- Boundary conditions: The patch must fit within the image.
